label: What changed in metacheck
values: A DataONE file identifier with slashes is kept whole, it was cut at its last slash; a file with no usable identifier is found by name in the node's search, which works again on KNB.; An OSF project with a linked GitHub repository is listed through GitHub, so its rows have the same address and path as the GitHub repository's own rows. repo_check keeps each file once, under OSF, which comes first.; data_check unpacks a compressed tar file (.tar.gz) inside a deposit and classifies the files in it, also when it lies inside a zip file. The earlier results list it as one file of unknown type.; DSpace repositories are recognised from doi.org's handle service and by host name, and a repository's former address is recognised.; metacheck's table of file types (file_types.rda) changed: .json counts as data only (it was code and data), .js, .ts and .tsx as code only, .html as a web page and no longer as code; shapefile parts and .ply count as data. The earlier results of these papers were made before this change.; osf_info() lists a project's whole tree of components and folders. The earlier listing of this project held 96 files, the final listing 131.; repo_check follows a Dryad sharing link (datadryad.org/stash/share/...), the link made for reviewers, to the dataset it leads to. It carries no DOI, so the paper had no repository.; repo_check keeps the files of an R package at a repository's root when the only files outside it configure services such as Travis, codecov or GitHub Actions. These files have the extension .yml, which counts as code, so the package looked like a bundled dependency and its files were removed.; repo_check removes a final . , ; or : from a repository address. With the full stop that ended a sentence the address led nowhere, and the deposit was listed without files.; The final run does not download the SAPFLUXNET deposit of 10.1111/1365-2664.14383, on the authors' decision, because of its size; code/run_metacheck.R lists the paper in no_download.; The final run holds a saved copy of these files, and the earlier results do not. For a .txt file, data_check reads the content of a saved copy and calls it data when it is a table (txt_classify_content(), since e1b5aa17, 2026-08-12), which explains the three papers with .txt data. Why the earlier runs have no copy was not established; no change in metacheck was found that explains it.; With osf_license = TRUE, repo_check reads the license of an OSF project through its registration when the project address does not answer. The final run sets this argument.
